audience: accounting teams with ABRA Flexi Cloud and a dedicated REST API user

useCases.title: Review issued and received invoices
useCases.text: List issued invoices and inspect a received invoice with its line items.

useCases.title: Check stock and pricing
useCases.text: Read products, stock cards and stock movements to investigate availability and pricing.

useCases.title: Review bank and cash movements
useCases.text: Read bank statement lines and cash-desk movements for a selected period. These tools do not execute payments.

useCases.title: Prepare an issued invoice
useCases.text: Inspect the customer and validate invoice input with dry_run before saving. Saving may book accounting entries or affect stock according to the document type.
